cards.title: Trust Receipts & Payments
cards.description: Chronological journal of all trust receipts and payments for a date range.

cards.title: Trust Creditors List (Rule 54.15)
cards.description: Every person and non-client creditor for whom trust money is held, as at a date — the locked monthly list where one exists.

cards.title: Trust Position as at a Date
cards.description: The cashbook against every trust creditor as at any date, per account and firm-wide, with the integrity flags.

cards.title: Client Ledger Statement
cards.description: Per-client transaction history with running balance.

cards.title: Trust Reconciliation
cards.description: Bank, cashbook and trust creditors compared at the reconciliation's period end, with the stored creditor breakdown.

cards.title: Investment Register
cards.description: Every trust investment on the books: account, basis, principal, balance and interest — gross, the Fund's 5% and net.

cards.title: Interest and Charges Schedule (Rule 54.28)
cards.description: Rule 54.28: interest earned and charges levied per trust account and month, the Fund ledger brought forward and carried forward; memo figures shown separately.

cards.title: Unidentified Deposits Age Analysis
cards.description: Unidentified deposits open as at a date by age band, and those allocated or paid to the Fund in the twelve months to it.

cards.title: Section 35 Data Pack
cards.description: Composite report combining all trust sub-reports for Section 35 compliance.
